characters.summary: An aging Bruce Wayne relies on an exo-skeletal harness to support his broken body, commanding an army of robotic Bat-Knights and automated defenses from the Batcave. He fights using advanced tech, tactical command, and strategic preparation.
weaknesses: Physical frailties of advanced age mitigated only by mechanical support
limitations: Physically disabled without his exo-skeletal support harness
characters.formDifferences: Represents an older Bruce Wayne whose physical limitations are offset by an exo-skeletal support rig and automated robotic forces.

sources.supports: Details on aging Bruce Wayne and his exo-skeletal gear.

feats.claim: Maintained global surveillance and security operations using automated Bat-Knights

notableResults.note: Engaged in ideological and physical conflict during the climax before peace was restored.

campaignTags.claim: Wears an exo-skeletal support harness to compensate for physical decay
Commands an automated force of robotic Bat-Knights
Utilizes advanced futuristic Batman utility equipment

unknowns: Full combat effectiveness in hand-to-hand combat without technological assistance.

characters.continuity: DC Comics - Dark Nights: Metal / Dark Multiverse
characters.summary: Infected with Joker toxin mixed with Bruce Wayne's intellect, The Batman Who Laughs fights with sadistic psychological warfare, corrupted Robins on chains, and Nth metal weaponry. He anticipates every move with terrifying cunning.
weaknesses: Underestimates opponents who act entirely unpredictably or outside logical paradigms
limitations: Possesses normal human physical stats without supernatural enhancements (prior to Darkest Knight form)
characters.formDifferences: Combines Batman's tactical genius with the uninhibited sadism and Joker toxin infection, wearing a spiked visor.

sources.supports: Overview of The Batman Who Laughs character, background, and gear.

feats.claim: Murdered the entire Bat-Family and Justice League of his universe in a single night

notableResults.note: Used specialized Joker-infected Kryptonite to kill Superman.

campaignTags.claim: Utilizes specialized Dark Multiverse tactical gear and Nth metal weapons

unknowns: Full extent of multiversal contingency plans before ascending to The Darkest Knight.

characters.continuity: DC Comics - Dark Nights: Death Metal
characters.summary: Having transferred his brain into a cosmic body formed from Superboy-Prime's energy and ultimate crisis residue, The Darkest Knight commands godlike reality-warping power, dark matter manipulation, and absolute control over the multiverse.
weaknesses: Hubris and dependence on maintaining stability over the unstable Crisis energy
limitations: Requires vast amounts of crisis energy to maintain his ultimate cosmic form
characters.formDifferences: Elevates The Batman Who Laughs into a cosmic god entity with ultimate reality-warping powers derived from crisis energy.

sources.supports: Details on The Darkest Knight's origin and cosmic abilities.

feats.claim: Remade the entire Multiverse into his own dark image

notableResults.note: Defeated and drained the energy of the multiversal creator Perpetua.

conditional.dependsOn: Possession of the ultimate crisis energy body

unknowns: Absolute upper ceiling of his reality-warping potential before destabilizing.

characters.summary: Kate Kane is a military-trained vigilante who fights with exceptional tactical firearms, batons, high-tech gadgets, and rigorous hand-to-hand combat proficiency. She excels at tactical operations and armed engagements.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to standard human biological limitations and injuries

sources.supports: Overview of Batwoman's military training, equipment, and combat style.

feats.claim: Subdued multiple armed mercenaries simultaneously using military close-quarters combat

notableResults.note: Defeated terrorist cells using tactical planning and close combat.

campaignTags.claim: Employs high-tech batarangs, grappling hooks, and tactical gear
Pilots specialized Batwoman aircraft and tactical vehicles

unknowns: Performance against high-tier cosmic entities without Justice League backup.

characters.continuity: DC Comics - Modern Era / Teen Titans
characters.summary: Garfield Logan transforms into any animal—extinct, mythological, or modern—retaining the physical traits, size, and abilities of the chosen creature. He fights with versatile shapeshifting, ferocious animal attacks, and quick adaptation.

mechanisms: Thick hides and shells of transformed animals
Agile dodging in smaller animal forms

weaknesses: Retains animal instincts or vulnerabilities when trapped in specific forms for too long
limitations: Must remain a living creature when shifting; cannot transform into inanimate objects

sources.supports: Details on Beast Boy's shapeshifting powers and animal transformation abilities.

feats.claim: Transformed into a T-Rex to smash through armored security doors

notableResults.note: Used varied multi-animal assaults to dismantle cult defenses.
